document.heading: ### 9.159 HB-2 E2-P0：tool取得・image／設定・独立承認・検証workspace契約（設計）

acquisition.primary: custodian offline mirror from official tagged source; reproducible isolated image build
acquisition.fallback: explicit versioned binary release with independent digest/provenance approval
acquisition.buildWorkspace: separate approved custody-capacity profile required; proof-job quota is not build capacity
acquisition.lockSource: independent custody manifest plus independently approved digests; never producer supplied replacements

solver.versionBinding: CBMC 6.8.0 exact built-in solver source/build manifest

image.baseOSCandidate: Ubuntu 24.04 LTS amd64 snapshot locked by digest

configuration.loopLimits: per loop exact full maximum including final condition; no generic guessed global unwind
configuration.compilerSuffix: manifest-bound input and output paths only; no caller argv

trust.candidateSignature: Ed25519 with independent registry pinned public keys

job.deadline: controller monotonic earliest original job/lease/approval expiration; never extend on retry

store.replicasAndBackups: additional separately reserved storage, never hidden in slot

controller.watchdogFailurePolicy: independent manager fences and kills job subtree on controller loss; no publish or credit before durable reconciliation
controller.clock: controller monotonic bound to incarnation; restart fences old job rather than resetting deadline

copyGate.after: all actual reservations committed for the same job
copyGate.postCopyGate: fresh same checks plus actual sealed-input identity/digest before exec
copyGate.failure: no candidate IO; persist refusal and retain charged work/reservation debt until reconciliation

publishGate.clock: trusted mapped monotonic clock at commit; never caller supplied now

lifecycle.bootstrap: independently provisioned controller/bootstrap capacity before any candidate load; job never proves its own verifier limit
lifecycle.restart: persist fence and debt before new job acceptance; old permit response output and cached result cannot publish
lifecycle.failedResult: retain consumed work slot and quarantine until independent reconciliation; no success on incomplete logs

reviewCases.counts: started operations, not completed copies or bytes

plan.next: P0 remains unsupported until independently provisioned; model-only source preparation is not proof execution or adoption

conditions.condition: official取得元と選択版を固定しlatest／浮動tag／任意mirrorへ変更したlockを拒否
source commit／archive／dependency／builder／tool／image digestの未取得はunsupported
版表示一致だけでは別binary／Apple Clang／別ABIの代替を受理しない
組込みsolverのsource／build／containing imageの対応欠落・外部solver fallbackを拒否
署名済upstream packageを独立method／環境承認へ昇格しない
base image／sysroot／linker／shared library／loader／kernel profileの未被覆を拒否
実Linux amd64／LP64／little-endian／CHAR_BITとmodel・compilerの不一致を拒否
argv／有効default／preprocessor／headers／entrypoint／loop表未固定時は実行前unsupported
検査無効化・cover／partial loop／depth／property限定と未知solver設定を拒否
shell／response file／環境変数／PATH／compiler pluginによる引数・code注入を拒否
全property・全loopと終了条件を被覆せず最大値を縮めたjobを拒否
取得・buildをquarantineで行い署名／digest検証前にjobを実行しない
producer／custodian／runnerによるmethod・環境の自己承認を拒否
実principal／key／store ACLの欠落はrole名があってもunsupported
別UID／署名だけで意味的証明や実容量制御を成立させない
methodとenvironment承認のsubject／kind／key／profile取り違えを拒否
registryの旧revision・失効／期限切れ・未承認keyへの切替を拒否
承認が読取後・実行中・seal後公開前に失効した場合も公開0
job ID／nonce／incarnation／source／tool／approval／予約の異なる結果流用を拒否
有界bootstrap・制御metadata容量がない場合はcandidateを読まずunsupported
copy／exec前にmemory・disk・inode・store・controllerの全枠を予約できなければ拒否
8 GiB memory.max等のpolicy値を厳密な瞬間physical上界や元1 MiBへ換算しない
runnerがquota／watchdog／clock／network設定を変更できるdeploymentを拒否
scratch／evidence双方とinodeの上限超過・scanだけの容量判定を拒否
stdout／stderrの各16 MiB上限・metadata capを超えた不完全結果を成功にしない
600秒・承認／leaseの早い期限で停止し、clock換算未取得／誤差1000 ms超を拒否、retry／再起動で元期限を延長しない
停止要求だけでdrainedとせず子process／FD／書込残存中の公開・枠再利用を拒否
失敗・timeout・kill・保存失敗・不明solver結果から成功envelopeを発行しない
再試行前に旧jobの停止／fence・debt保存を確認し旧枠を無料再初期化しない
controller終了時は外部watchdogで停止し、再起動後は旧permit／response／cache採用を拒否して失効を先に保存
保持4 slot・168時間経過だけで解放せずstore満杯時は新jobを拒否
別replica／backup／診断receiver・caller copyを無料にしない
symlink／mount／path置換／未記録file・atomic保存失敗時はseal／公開を拒否
controllerの容量・watchdog・stream capture自体の未予約をrunner枠で隠蔽しない
元memory／work／provider／global親と中間unitを維持しjob容量の余りで相殺しない
proof生成と読取／hash／署名／消費の予約を分離しHB14未成立で本番読取しない
tool導入／image build／method承認／quota制御の未実施を設計flagで成功にしない
model proofとcompiled object／native stack／全18領域の採用判定を分離
ED-1再照合のcommand・summary全件とhash更新後の拒否、旧source pinを維持
P0条件が揃わなければunsupportedを保持しE2-P1準備を証明／permitへ昇格しない
全予約完了後・最初のcandidate IO直前にcurrent registry／両承認・元期限・epoch／fenceを再検査
予約中の取消し／期限切れ／revision変更時はcandidate open／read／map／copy・exec・公開を全て0
copy後もexec直前にfreshな同条件と実input identityを再検査し、copy中の失効ならexec／公開0
tool成功後の結果検証・drain・seal中に元job／lease／approval期限へ達した場合は公開0
元期限と同値・kill猶予内・猶予終了時も成功公開を拒否しtool終了／sealで期限を再設定しない
最後のcallback／await／IO後の公開transactionで元期限・current承認・停止／失効・epoch／予約fenceを照合し、間に非同期処理が入れば再検査
